items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Louis Kepp. See, he had manager and leader... Louis Kepp played guitar. We had a good band.

ctx.x: Who was the leader of the Magnolia Band? And who was the leader of the Magnolia Band?
Louis Kepp. Louis Kepp. See, he had manager and leader.
